headline: Ireland Rent Increase Rate Slows to 7.3% in Third Quarter
summary: Residential market rent hikes in Ireland slowed during Q3 to their lowest growth pace in six years. Average monthly rents reached €2,239, up 7.3% year-on-year.
why: Housing costs and rental market trends serve as major inputs for consumer price inflation and real estate policy in Ireland.

impacts.name: Ireland
impacts.why: Slower rent inflation reduces cost-of-living growth pressures on Irish consumer budgets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
